title: Continuous retraction onto a nonempty closed subset of a countable discrete product
statement: Let $(E_i)_{i\in\mathbf N}$ be a sequence of sets with their discrete topologies, and give $P=\prod_{i\in\mathbf N}E_i$ the product topology. Let $A\subseteq P$ be a nonempty closed subset with the induced topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Then there is a continuous surjection $r:P\to A$ such that $r(a)=a$ for every $a\in A$ (where $a$ is viewed in $P$ on the left). No finiteness or compactness assumption on the factors is required. Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].
